description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the 'git rebase --fork-point' command in various scenarios. It defines functions, sets up git repositories, and executes multiple rebase commands with different options to validate expected outcomes.

methods.name: do_test_rebase
methods.description: Performs a git rebase with specified parameters and compares the resulting commit log to an expected output.

methods.name: test_rebase
methods.description: Wrapper that runs 'do_test_rebase' within a test expectation, simplifying test invocation with descriptive output.
